{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.22

|branch= dev

|arg= global
|eff= local

|gr1= Sensors

|descr= Sets target size (see <syntaxhighlight lang="cpp" inline>irTargetSize</syntaxhighlight> and others from vehicle config) override on vehicle.
{{Feature|informative|Passing an empty array returns the current values without modifying them, so this commands works as both getter and setter.}}

|s1= vehicle [[setTargetSize]] [visualTargetSize, irTargetSize, radarTargetSize]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - a transport vehicle

|p2= visualTargetSize: [[Number]] - 0..2 value, set to -1 to disable override and use config values

|p3= irTargetSize: [[Number]]

|p4= radarTargetSize: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Array]] with previous [visualTargetSize, irTargetSize, radarTargetSize] values

|x1= <sqf>private _previousSizes = vehicle player setTargetSize [0,0,0]; // set</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _currentSizes = vehicle player setTargetSize []; // get</sqf>

|seealso= [[getSensorTargets]]
}}
